dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Moderately concave curve on the trailing edge, exhibiting a distinct falcate spline from the posterior base to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute apex with a slightly rounded pixel radius at the terminal point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Convex anterior margin with an approximate 45 to 50-degree incline relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Base width is approximately 1.4 times the vertical height of the fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple light-colored linear striae (rake marks or scratches) visible on the lateral flank below the dorsal fin; minor irregularities along the posterior trailing edge of the dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible caudal peduncle and tail fluke morphology, including a distinct notch and trailing edge curvature of the flukes.
